specialization: Sunstead pins Bert Dobbelaere’s SorterHunter minimum-depth sorting-network benchmarks for n = 9..16 (including Sort_9_25_7.json, Sort_10_31_7.json, Sort_12_40_8.json, Sort_16_61_9.json, README.md, SorterHunter.cpp, and sorting_networks.html) and formalizes parallel layer semantics, pairwise wire disjointness, Knuth’s Zero-One Principle, and a bit-sliced kernel evaluator in pure Lean 4.36.0. Each track starts from a textbook Odd-Even Transposition Sort seed (depth n) and challenges contributors to minimize parallel depth D(n).
